en: A black‑and‑white view of a formal city park or promenade framed by symmetrical tree‑lined paths and flowerbeds, leading toward a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance building at the center background. The building has three main stories with arched windows and a colonnaded ground floor; in front of it stands a fountain or statue in a circular basin. Multi‑story 19th‑century townhouses line both sides of the park. Low hills or forested slopes rise behind the city. There is faint signage on one of the left‑hand buildings.
